title: File Transfer
hint: Left: this computer. Right: {device}. Select, then send — or drag between the panes, or drop files from Finder onto the right pane.
sendHint: Copy the selected items into the folder open on {device}
getHint: Copy the selected items from {device} into the folder open on this computer
deleteOne: Delete “{name}”? A folder is deleted with everything in it. This cannot be undone.
deleteMany: Delete {count} items? Folders are deleted with everything in them. This cannot be undone.
truncated: Showing only the first {count} items of this folder.

conflict.title: Already exists
conflict.fileExists: A file named “{name}” already exists in the destination folder.
conflict.folderExists: A folder named “{name}” already exists in the destination folder.
conflict.fileHint: Replace it, keep both (the copy gets a numbered name), or skip this file.
conflict.folderHint: Merge into it (files with the same name are replaced), keep both (the copy gets a numbered name), or skip this folder.
conflict.applyToAll: Do this for all remaining conflicts

errors.fileChanged: The file changed while it was being copied.
errors.integrity: Integrity check failed: the copy does not match the original (SHA-256).
errors.tooMany: too many items in this folder (more than 10,000)
